eMbrace for Corporates

Building Mentally Resilient, Inclusive Workplaces

At eMbrace, we partner with forward-thinking organizations to embed structured, stigma-free mental health solutions into the workplace.

From therapy access to leadership training and neurodiversity programs, our confidential and evidence-based approach helps employees and teams thrive.

Why Corporates Choose eMbrace

Neurodiversity & Inclusion

Expert-led awareness programs on Autism, ADHD, and building inclusive workspaces.

Confidential EAP & Assessments

Therapy, burnout screening, and neuropsychological evaluations with 100% privacy.

Manager & HR Training

Upskilling leaders to identify, respond to, and manage workplace mental health.

Culture of Well-Being

Empowering teams, reducing attrition, and fostering productivity through resilience.

Free · 3 minutes · private

Stressed, or burnt out? They need different things.

Our self-check gives you four separate scores — worry, mood, body and sleep, and burnout — because those four problems look identical from the outside and respond to completely different treatment. Your answers stay in your browser, and the 7-Day Reset Plan has a track for whichever one is heaviest.
